summary.text: David Hogue is a Republican member of the North Dakota Senate, representing District 38 (Minot) in the 2025-26 Legislative Assembly. The legislature's biography lists David Hogue's service as "Senate since 2009". The member page lists David Hogue as Majority Leader and as chairing Legislative Management.

paragraphs.text: The biography lists David Hogue's occupation as Attorney.
It lists education as BA, Cornell College; U.S. Army War College; JD, UND.
It lists military service as Veteran.
